# Bridges Global — Bridges Live

> Bridges Global runs Bridges Live, where homes in Tampa Bay, Sarasota and Austin are toured on live video, including for clients relocating from other states and countries. Viewers ask questions in real time and request a private showing in one tap. Real estate services are provided by Dorota Maslowska, Broker Associate with LPT Realty (Florida license BK3519799, Texas license 829789-SA), in English and Polish.

## Priority pages
- [Home — watch Tampa Bay real estate live](https://live.bridgesglobal.co/): live tours, featured homes, areas served, how it works.
- [Bridges Live — live tours & recent walkthroughs](https://live.bridgesglobal.co/live-marketplace): every live stream and recent video tour.
- [Buy a home](https://live.bridgesglobal.co/buy): shortlist on live video, visit only the one.
- [Homes for sale](https://live.bridgesglobal.co/listings): active Stellar MLS listings (IDX) with listing-brokerage attribution, or a link to the full MLS search.
- [Neighborhoods](https://live.bridgesglobal.co/neighborhoods): Tampa Bay, Sarasota and Austin neighborhoods, each toured live on video on request.
- [Dorota Maslowska, Broker Associate](https://live.bridgesglobal.co/dorota-maslowska): licenses, languages, services.
- [New construction](https://live.bridgesglobal.co/new-construction): buyer representation with builders across Tampa Bay.
- [Relocation to Tampa Bay](https://live.bridgesglobal.co/relocation): moving from another state or country.
- [Apartment locating](https://live.bridgesglobal.co/apartment-locating): matched communities, move-in specials and live unit tours.
- [Sell your home](https://live.bridgesglobal.co/sell): showings streamed live to buyers.
- [Stream on Bridges Live](https://live.bridgesglobal.co/become-a-streamer): for licensed agents and builders.

## Areas served
Tampa Bay and Sarasota (Florida), Austin (Texas), and relocation from anywhere. Florida communities: Tampa, Brandon, Riverview, Apollo Beach, Ruskin, Lithia & FishHawk, Sun City Center, Wimauma, Wesley Chapel, Parrish, Lakewood Ranch, Bradenton, Sarasota, St. Petersburg, Clearwater (Florida).

## Facts
- Brokerage: LPT Realty. Bridges Global and Bridges Live are marketing and technology services, not a brokerage.
- Earnest money is never collected through the website.
- Contact: 813-781-8888 · dd@bridgesglobal.co
- Giving back: a portion of every Bridges transaction supports Gift of God Ministries, a separate 501(c)(3) nonprofit providing housing education and relocation resources (https://giftofgodministries.org/housing-ministry/).
